figurative_meaning_bn: হিন্দুদের শ্রাদ্ধানুষ্ঠানের পর মাছ খেয়ে নিয়মভঙ্গ করার অনুষ্ঠান
figurative_meaning_en: The ritual of breaking dietary rules by eating fish after the Hindu shraddha ceremony
similar_in_english: breaking the fast (in a ritualistic sense)
example_sentences_in_bangla: শ্রাদ্ধ শেষে তারা মৎস্যমুখ করে নিয়ম ভঙ্গ করল।
পারিবারিক ঐতিহ্য অনুসারে মৎস্যমুখের অনুষ্ঠান সম্পন্ন হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: After the shraddha, they performed matsya-mukha to break the rules by eating fish.
The family completed the matsya-mukha ritual as per tradition.
history: This idiom refers to a traditional Bengali Hindu practice following the shraddha ceremony, where a period of vegetarianism is observed, and eating fish marks the end of the mourning restrictions.
note: Specific to Bengali Hindu communities; synonyms indicate variations in pronunciation or regional usage.
